name: numbered step card beside a cursor editing the product
looks: A numbered badge, a two-line bold claim and a short caption sit at the left of the frame; to the right, a browser-window mockup of the product holds steady as a cursor flies in, clicks a label, and an edit panel appears over it. The camera holds the frame, then the whole pairing cross-fades to the next numbered step with a new claim and a new product view.
build: gallery-zoom-tour's camera-through-many-pieces pattern, slowed to a soft cross-fade between fixed compositions instead of a whip; each product view is a DOM browser-chrome frame around a screenshot, with a cursor glyph animated on power3.inOut paths (glass-ui-flow) for the click-and-edit beat.
sound: A soft click on the cursor's press, a quiet whoosh on the cross-fade between steps.
prompt: Pair a numbered step label and a short claim at one side of the frame with a framed product screenshot at the other, and animate a cursor flying in to click an element and open a small edit panel over it. Hold the composition, then push the whole pairing out as the next numbered step slides in with a new claim and a new product view, so the sequence reads as one guided walkthrough.
